users_has_identifier.name: users_has_identifier
users_has_identifier.value: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."status" = 'DELETED'

garments_customer_matches_status.name: garments_customer_matches_status
garments_customer_matches_status.value: "garments"."current_customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "garments"."status" NOT IN ('WITH_CUSTOMER', 'RETURN_REQUESTED')

discounts_has_target.name: discounts_has_target
discounts_has_target.value: "discounts"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "discounts"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL

promotions_value_matches_type.name: promotions_value_matches_type
promotions_value_matches_type.value:
("promotions"."discount_type" = 'PERCENTAGE' AND "promotions"."percent_basis_points" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "promotions"."fixed_amount" IS NULL)
        OR ("promotions"."discount_type" = 'FIXED_AMOUNT' AND "promotions"."fixed_amount" > 0 AND "promotions"."percent_basis_points" IS NULL)
        OR ("promotions"."discount_type" = 'FREE_SHIPPING' AND "promotions"."fixed_amount" IS NULL AND "promotions"."percent_basis_points" IS NULL)

payments_has_target.name: payments_has_target
payments_has_target.value: "payments"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payments"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL

exchange_credits_sign_matches_type.name: exchange_credits_sign_matches_type
exchange_credits_sign_matches_type.value:
("exchange_credits"."entry_type" = 'EARNED' AND "exchange_credits"."amount" > 0)
        OR ("exchange_credits"."entry_type" IN ('REDEEMED', 'EXPIRED') AND "exchange_credits"."amount" < 0)
        OR ("exchange_credits"."entry_type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND "exchange_credits"."amount" <> 0)

return_items_outcome_requires_inspection.name: return_items_outcome_requires_inspection
return_items_outcome_requires_inspection.value: "return_items"."outcome" IS NULL OR ("return_items"."inspected_condition" IS NOT NULL AND "return_items"."inspected_at" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_target_matches_direction.name: deliveries_target_matches_direction
deliveries_target_matches_direction.value:
("deliveries"."direction" = 'OUTBOUND' AND "deliveries"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("deliveries"."direction" = 'RETURN_PICKUP' AND "deliveries"."return_request_id" IS NOT NULL)
